latestVersion.changelog:
marswave-image-gen 0.1.0

- Initial release of the image-gen skill for generating AI images from text prompts.
- Supports interactive multi-step flow: prompt, model, resolution, aspect ratio, reference images (optional), confirmation.
- Offers prompt enrichment for short prompts.
- Uses the Labnana API with two model options ("pro" and "flash").
- Outputs images inline, for download, or both, based on user configuration.
- Enforces structured config handling and strict error/retry policies.
